In detail

No specific dated safety incidents were found in French press coverage for Batignolles. It's a family-oriented, gentrified quartier around Square des Batignolles and the newer Clichy-Batignolles/Martin Luther King park, generally considered one of the calmer parts of the 17th arrondissement. No particular concern is documented for day or night.
